title: Filters
summary: Cold, dark and damaged treatments shown on the sample clip (over the theme's cold grade, as footage in this theme normally is): a drained base grade and night tint, vignette and fog, film and tape damage, failing light, and slow distortions. Previews run at full strength; use less in a video.
usage: In a footage storyboard: {"footage": {"look": {"name": "cold_grade", "amount": 0.8}}} and {"name": "lamp_flicker", "at": 2.4, "seconds": 0.6, "amount": 0.9}. On a shot candidate: {"effect": {"name": "static_burst", "amount": 0.8, "where": "in", "seconds": 0.4}}. This theme's own effects: library/themes/horror/effects/theme_effects.py; grain and camera_shake come from library/_shared/effects_engine.py.

items.name: cold grade
items.description: The theme base look: most of the colour drained, shadows pushed teal-grey and crushed, no clean whites. Use around 0.8 on footage.

items.name: night tint
items.description: Day for night: underexposed and blue-violet, with only the brightest things left glowing.

items.name: heavy vignette
items.description: Darkness closing round the picture: a deep, slowly wandering vignette that leaves only the middle lit.

items.name: dark fog
items.description: Cold mist drifting low through the frame while the picture dims under it.

items.name: grain
items.description: Fine film grain (shared engine).

items.name: film damage
items.description: Worn film stock: gate weave, exposure flutter, running scratches, dust, hairs and heavy grain.

items.name: vhs tracking
items.description: A tape watched too many times: washed-out colour bleeding sideways, tracking bands that tear the picture, head-switch noise along the bottom.

items.name: static burst
items.description: Signal loss: the picture breaks into dead-channel noise and rows tear sideways. For cuts and jolts.

items.name: lamp flicker
items.description: A failing bulb: the picture holds, then dips hard or cuts to near black for a frame or two, with no rhythm.

items.name: blackout
items.description: Hard cuts to black for a few frames at a time; more often as the amount rises.

items.name: cold flash
items.description: A cut flash that burns out to cold blue-grey instead of white.

items.name: slow warp
items.description: The picture breathes and bends very slowly, as if seen through old glass or deep water.

items.name: streak smear
items.description: Columns of the picture drag into long vertical streaks and thin out, the way the theme's lettering leaves.

items.name: mirror seam
items.description: The picture folds onto itself down the middle, so everything becomes symmetrical and wrong.

items.name: creep zoom
items.description: The slow push-in, with a faint hand-held tremble.

items.name: camera shake
items.description: A jolt of hand-held shake (shared engine).

items.name: spotlight
items.description: A warm pool of light from above on the person; the room falls away to near-black. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: rim light
items.description: Dark, cool scene; a thin bright outline traces the person. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: flashlight
items.description: A hard round beam on the face that drifts a little; everything else dark. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: golden hour
items.description: Low warm sun with leaf shadows dappled across the scene. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: neon
items.description: Hot magenta from one side, a cyan touch from the other, dark in between. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: projector
items.description: A bright lamp flaring behind the head through haze, teal room. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: under light
items.description: Light from below: the campfire or horror look. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: low key
items.description: Mostly shadow: one small key on the face, deep blacks. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: silhouette
items.description: Bright hazy background, the person a dark shape with a faint edge. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: cop lights
items.description: The room drops dark and red and blue police lights strobe across the person from both sides. Options ("props"): color, color2 (hex), speed (flashes per second, 2.2), push (1.08).

items.name: colour grade
items.description: The look changes on a word: moody, warm, cool, black and white or pop fades in (or ripples out from a point). Options ("props"): grade (moody, warm, cool, bw, pop), style (fade or ripple), dur (seconds to arrive), x, y (ripple origin, 0–1). Also works as a footage "look".
